# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_culture_merges.py - do not edit manually.

# Each entry is added two ways: the engine activates a candidate's inactive record once both
# is_shown_when_inactive and possible hold, and the yearly census (te_cmg_<m>_settle) adds one to a country
# that holds no record, behind the entry's own gate and a skip of any inactive copy
# (test_add_journal_entry_guard.py). Merge mechanics never key on the entry.

# ---- german (north_german, south_german) ----
je_te_cm_german = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_german_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_german_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_german_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
					te_cmg_german_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_german_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_german_north_german
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_hold_north_german
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_german_north_german
					var:te_cm_held_german_north_german < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_accept_north_german
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_german_north_german
					var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_hold_south_german
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_german_south_german
					var:te_cm_held_german_south_german < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_german_status_accept_south_german
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
							te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_german_south_german
					var:te_cm_ok_german_south_german = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_german ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_german_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_german_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			te_cmg_german_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_german_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_german value = te_cmg_german_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_german_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_german }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

				trigger = {
					NOT = {

					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {

				trigger = {
					te_cmg_italian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_italian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_italian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
			te_cmg_italian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_italian_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_italian_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_italian_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_italian value = te_cmg_italian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_italian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_italian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

				trigger = {
					te_cmg_scandinavian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_scandinavian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_scandinavian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
			te_cmg_scandinavian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_scandinavian_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_scandinavian value = te_cmg_scandinavian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_scandinavian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_scandinavian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- east_slavic (russian, ukrainian, byelorussian) ----
je_te_cm_east_slavic = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_east_slavic_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_east_slavic_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_east_slavic_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
					te_cmg_east_slavic_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_east_slavic_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_east_slavic_russian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_hold_russian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_east_slavic_russian
					var:te_cm_held_east_slavic_russian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_accept_russian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_east_slavic_russian
					var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_russian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_hold_ukrainian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_east_slavic_ukrainian
					var:te_cm_held_east_slavic_ukrainian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_accept_ukrainian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_east_slavic_ukrainian
					var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_ukrainian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_hold_byelorussian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_east_slavic_byelorussian
					var:te_cm_held_east_slavic_byelorussian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_accept_byelorussian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_east_slavic_byelorussian
					var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_byelorussian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_wait_ukrainian
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_start_basics = yes
					te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_waiting = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_status_wait_byelorussian
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_start_basics = yes
					te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_waiting = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_east_slavic_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			te_cmg_east_slavic_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_east_slavic value = te_cmg_east_slavic_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_east_slavic_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_east_slavic }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

					global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_hold_czech
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_czechoslovak_czech
					var:te_cm_held_czechoslovak_czech < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_accept_czech
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech
					var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_hold_slovak
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_czechoslovak_slovak
					var:te_cm_held_czechoslovak_slovak < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_status_accept_slovak
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
							te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak
					var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_czechoslovak_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_czechoslovak value = te_cmg_czechoslovak_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_czechoslovak_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_czechoslovak }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- hungarian (hungarian, szekely) ----
je_te_cm_hungarian = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_hungarian_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hungarian_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_hungarian_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_hungarian_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
					te_cmg_hungarian_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hungarian_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_hold_hungarian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_hungarian_hungarian
					var:te_cm_held_hungarian_hungarian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_accept_hungarian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian
					var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_hold_szekely
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_hungarian_szekely
					var:te_cm_held_hungarian_szekely < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_status_accept_szekely
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely
					var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hungarian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_hungarian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
			te_cmg_hungarian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_hungarian_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_hungarian value = te_cmg_hungarian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_hungarian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_hungarian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_finnish_status_hold_finnish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_finnish_finnish_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_finnish_finnish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_finnish }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_finnish_finnish
					var:te_cm_held_finnish_finnish < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_finnish_status_accept_finnish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_finnish_finnish_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_finnish_finnish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_finnish }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_finnish_finnish
					var:te_cm_ok_finnish_finnish = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_finnish_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_finnish_karelian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_finnish_status_hold_karelian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_finnish_karelian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_finnish_karelian
					var:te_cm_held_finnish_karelian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_finnish_status_accept_karelian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_finnish_karelian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_finnish_karelian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_finnish_karelian
					var:te_cm_ok_finnish_karelian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_finnish ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_finnish_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_finnish_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_finnish_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 2
			te_cmg_finnish_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_finnish_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_finnish value = te_cmg_finnish_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_finnish_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_finnish }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- french (french, wallonian, occitan) ----
je_te_cm_french = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_french_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_french_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_french_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_french_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
					te_cmg_french_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_french_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_french_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_french_french
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_french_french_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_hold_french
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_french_french_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_french_french
					var:te_cm_held_french_french < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_accept_french
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_french_french_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_french_french
					var:te_cm_ok_french_french = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_hold_wallonian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_french_wallonian
					var:te_cm_held_french_wallonian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_accept_wallonian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_french_wallonian
					var:te_cm_ok_french_wallonian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_french_occitan_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_hold_occitan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_french_occitan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_french_occitan
					var:te_cm_held_french_occitan < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_french_status_accept_occitan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_french_occitan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_french_occitan
					var:te_cm_ok_french_occitan = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_french ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_french_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_french_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
			te_cmg_french_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_french_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_french value = te_cmg_french_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_french_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_french }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- british (british, scottish) ----
je_te_cm_british = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {

	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {

	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_british_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_british_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_british_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_british_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.

				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off

				}
			}

				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {

				trigger = {
					te_cmg_british_has_other_starter = yes

				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_british_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_british_british
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_british_british_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_hold_british
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_british_british_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_british_british
					var:te_cm_held_british_british < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_accept_british
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_british_british_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_british_british
					var:te_cm_ok_british_british = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_british_scottish_available = yes
					}
				}

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_hold_scottish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_british_scottish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_british_scottish
					var:te_cm_held_british_scottish < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_british_status_accept_scottish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_british_scottish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_british_scottish
					var:te_cm_ok_british_scottish = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_british ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_british_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_british_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
			te_cmg_british_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	# And a candidate's entry once a higher merge has switched one of its core parts (R38): it can never start.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_british_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { te_cmg_british_core_left = yes }
					NOT = { te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_british value = te_cmg_british_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_british_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_british }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_american_yankee
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_american_yankee_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_hold_yankee
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_american_yankee_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_american_yankee
					var:te_cm_held_american_yankee < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_accept_yankee
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_american_yankee_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_american_yankee
					var:te_cm_ok_american_yankee = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_american_dixie_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_hold_dixie
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_american_dixie_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_american_dixie
					var:te_cm_held_american_dixie < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_accept_dixie
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
							te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_american_dixie_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_american_dixie
					var:te_cm_ok_american_dixie = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_american ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_american_status_wait_dixie
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_american_start_basics = yes
					te_cmg_american_dixie_waiting = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_american_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_american_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
			te_cmg_american_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	# And a candidate's entry once a higher merge has switched one of its core parts (R38): it can never start.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { te_cmg_american_core_left = yes }
					NOT = { te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_american value = te_cmg_american_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_american_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_american }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- anglophone (british, yankee/cm_american) ----
je_te_cm_anglophone = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_anglophone_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_anglophone_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
					te_cmg_anglophone_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_anglophone_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_anglophone_british
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_hold_british
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_anglophone_british
					var:te_cm_held_anglophone_british < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_accept_british
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_anglophone_british
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_years_british
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british
					NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
						te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_hold_yankee
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_anglophone_yankee
					var:te_cm_held_anglophone_yankee < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_accept_yankee
				trigger = {

						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {

				trigger = {

							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee
					NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_hold_cm_american
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_anglophone_cm_american
					var:te_cm_held_anglophone_cm_american < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_accept_cm_american
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_anglophone_cm_american
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_cm_american = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_anglophone_status_years_cm_american
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
							AND = {
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
								te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes

						}

					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
					var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_cm_american
					NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes }

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {

					}

				trigger = {

			te_cmg_anglophone_has_other_starter = yes
		}

					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_anglophone_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_anglophone }

							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_hold_nordestino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_brazilian_nordestino
					var:te_cm_held_brazilian_nordestino < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_accept_nordestino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_brazilian_nordestino
					var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_nordestino = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_hold_paulista
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_brazilian_paulista
					var:te_cm_held_brazilian_paulista < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_accept_paulista
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_brazilian_paulista
					var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_paulista = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_busy_4
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_hold_amazonic
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_brazilian_amazonic
					var:te_cm_held_brazilian_amazonic < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_accept_amazonic
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_brazilian_amazonic
					var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_amazonic = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_busy_5
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_hold_sulista
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_brazilian_sulista
					var:te_cm_held_brazilian_sulista < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_status_accept_sulista
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
							te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_brazilian_sulista
					var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_sulista = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_brazilian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_brazilian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2
			te_cmg_brazilian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_brazilian value = te_cmg_brazilian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_brazilian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_brazilian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- platine (platinean, argentine, uruguayan, paraguayan) ----
je_te_cm_platine = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_platine_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_platine_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_platine_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
					te_cmg_platine_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_platine_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_platine_platinean
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_hold_platinean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_platine_platinean
					var:te_cm_held_platine_platinean < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_accept_platinean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_platine_platinean
					var:te_cm_ok_platine_platinean = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_hold_argentine
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_platine_argentine
					var:te_cm_held_platine_argentine < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_accept_argentine
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_platine_argentine
					var:te_cm_ok_platine_argentine = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_hold_uruguayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_platine_uruguayan
					var:te_cm_held_platine_uruguayan < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_accept_uruguayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_platine_uruguayan
					var:te_cm_ok_platine_uruguayan = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_busy_4
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_hold_paraguayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_platine_paraguayan
					var:te_cm_held_platine_paraguayan < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_platine_status_accept_paraguayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_platine_paraguayan
					var:te_cm_ok_platine_paraguayan = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_platine ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_platine_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_platine_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
			te_cmg_platine_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	# And a candidate's entry once a higher merge has switched one of its core parts (R38): it can never start.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { te_cmg_platine_core_left = yes }
					NOT = { te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_platine value = te_cmg_platine_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_platine_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_platine }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- andean (north_andean, south_andean, peruvian, bolivian) ----
je_te_cm_andean = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

		always = yes
	}

		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}

		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_andean_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_andean_can_start = yes

		}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes

					}

					}

			}

				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_hold_north_andean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_andean_north_andean
					var:te_cm_held_andean_north_andean < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_accept_north_andean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_andean_north_andean
					var:te_cm_ok_andean_north_andean = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_andean_south_andean_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_hold_south_andean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_south_andean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_andean_south_andean
					var:te_cm_held_andean_south_andean < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_accept_south_andean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_south_andean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_andean_south_andean
					var:te_cm_ok_andean_south_andean = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_andean_peruvian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_hold_peruvian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
