					has_variable = te_cm_held_andean_peruvian
					var:te_cm_held_andean_peruvian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_accept_peruvian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_peruvian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_andean_peruvian
					var:te_cm_ok_andean_peruvian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_busy_4
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_andean_bolivian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_hold_bolivian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_bolivian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_andean_bolivian
					var:te_cm_held_andean_bolivian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_andean_status_accept_bolivian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_andean_bolivian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_andean_bolivian
					var:te_cm_ok_andean_bolivian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_andean ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_andean_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_andean_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_andean_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2
			te_cmg_andean_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_andean_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_andean value = te_cmg_andean_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_andean_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_andean }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- gran_colombian (colombian, venezuelan, ecuadorian) ----
je_te_cm_gran_colombian = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_gran_colombian_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_gran_colombian_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_hold_colombian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_gran_colombian_colombian
					var:te_cm_held_gran_colombian_colombian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_accept_colombian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian
					var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_gran_colombian_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes

						}
					}
					NOR = {

					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {

					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_chinese_status_hold_hakka
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_chinese_hakka
					var:te_cm_held_chinese_hakka < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_chinese_status_accept_hakka
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
							te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_chinese_hakka
					var:te_cm_ok_chinese_hakka = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_chinese ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_chinese_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_chinese_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_chinese_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2
			te_cmg_chinese_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_chinese_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_chinese value = te_cmg_chinese_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_chinese_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_chinese }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- japanese (japanese, ryukyuan) ----
je_te_cm_japanese = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_japanese_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_japanese_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_japanese_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_japanese_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_japanese_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_japanese_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 2
					te_cmg_japanese_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_japanese_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_japanese_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_japanese_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_japanese_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_japanese_japanese
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_hold_japanese
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_japanese_japanese
					var:te_cm_held_japanese_japanese < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_accept_japanese
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_japanese_japanese
					var:te_cm_ok_japanese_japanese = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_hold_ryukyuan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_japanese_ryukyuan
					var:te_cm_held_japanese_ryukyuan < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_japanese_status_accept_ryukyuan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_japanese_ryukyuan
					var:te_cm_ok_japanese_ryukyuan = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_japanese ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_japanese_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_japanese_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_japanese_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 2
			te_cmg_japanese_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_japanese_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_japanese value = te_cmg_japanese_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_japanese_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_japanese }
				}
			}
		}

			te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_persian_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_persian_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
					te_cmg_persian_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_persian_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_persian_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_persian_persian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_hold_persian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_persian_persian
					var:te_cm_held_persian_persian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_accept_persian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_persian_persian
					var:te_cm_ok_persian_persian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
							te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_hold_luri
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
							te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_persian_luri
					var:te_cm_held_persian_luri < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_persian_status_accept_luri
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
							te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_persian_luri
					var:te_cm_ok_persian_luri = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_persian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_persian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
			te_cmg_persian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_persian_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_persian value = te_cmg_persian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_persian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_persian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- oghuz_turkic (turkish, azerbaijani) ----
je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_oghuz_turkic_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_hold_turkish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_oghuz_turkic_turkish
					var:te_cm_held_oghuz_turkic_turkish < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_accept_turkish
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish
					var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_hold_azerbaijani
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
					var:te_cm_held_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_status_accept_azerbaijani
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
							te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani
					var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_oghuz_turkic value = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_oghuz_turkic }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

				trigger = {

				}

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hindustani_status_accept_chhattisgarhi
				trigger = {

						OR = {
							te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_hindustani_chhattisgarhi
					var:te_cm_ok_hindustani_chhattisgarhi = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hindustani_status_busy_5
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hindustani_status_hold_bageli
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_hindustani_bageli
					var:te_cm_held_hindustani_bageli < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_hindustani_status_accept_bageli
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
							te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_hindustani_bageli
					var:te_cm_ok_hindustani_bageli = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_hindustani_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_hindustani_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2
			te_cmg_hindustani_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_hindustani value = te_cmg_hindustani_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_hindustani_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_hindustani }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- dravidian (tamil, kannada, malayalam) ----
je_te_cm_dravidian = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_dravidian_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_dravidian_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_dravidian_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2
					te_cmg_dravidian_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_dravidian_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_dravidian_tamil
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_hold_tamil
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_dravidian_tamil
					var:te_cm_held_dravidian_tamil < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_accept_tamil
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_dravidian_tamil
					var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_tamil = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_dravidian_status_hold_kannada
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_dravidian_kannada

				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {

				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes

							te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
							te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes

							te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes

		}

		trigger = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_has_other_starter = yes
		}

	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {

	can_deactivate = no
}

					var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_malay = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_hold_sumatran
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sumatran }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_indonesian_sumatran
					var:te_cm_held_indonesian_sumatran < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_accept_sumatran
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sumatran }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_indonesian_sumatran
					var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_sumatran = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_busy_4
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_hold_bornean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_indonesian_bornean
					var:te_cm_held_indonesian_bornean < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_status_accept_bornean
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
							te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_indonesian_bornean
					var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_bornean = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_indonesian_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_indonesian_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_indonesian_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2
			te_cmg_indonesian_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_indonesian value = te_cmg_indonesian_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_indonesian_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_indonesian }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- filipino (filipino, visayan, tagalog, ilocano) ----
je_te_cm_filipino = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_filipino_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_filipino_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_filipino_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
					te_cmg_filipino_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_filipino_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_hold_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_filipino_filipino
					var:te_cm_held_filipino_filipino < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_accept_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino
					var:te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_hold_visayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_filipino_visayan
					var:te_cm_held_filipino_visayan < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_accept_visayan
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan
					var:te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_busy_3
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_hold_tagalog
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_filipino_tagalog
					var:te_cm_held_filipino_tagalog < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_accept_tagalog
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog
					var:te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_busy_4
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_hold_ilocano
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_filipino_ilocano
					var:te_cm_held_filipino_ilocano < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_filipino_status_accept_ilocano
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
							te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano
					var:te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_filipino ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_filipino_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_filipino_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
			te_cmg_filipino_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	# So does a candidate's entry once the merge's result has switched into a wider culture (R36): it can no
	# longer start, and only the starter (who has the complete outcome above) keeps the entry.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_has_other_starter = yes
				AND = {
					te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes
					NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_filipino value = te_cmg_filipino_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_filipino_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_filipino }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_latin_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_latin_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_latin_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_latin_french
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_latin_status_component_french
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_latin_status_component_italian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_latin_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {

			desc = te_cm_status_pending

	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_latin_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_latin_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2
			te_cmg_latin_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_latin_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_latin value = te_cmg_latin_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_latin_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_latin }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- pan_slavic (cm_east_slavic, cm_czechoslovak, cm_yugoslav) ----
je_te_cm_pan_slavic = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"
	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_pan_slavic_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_pan_slavic_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_slavic_status_complete

					te_cmg_pan_slavic_all_switched = yes

							te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_slavic_status_years_cm_yugoslav
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
					NOT = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = yes }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_slavic_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_pan_slavic_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_pan_slavic value = te_cmg_pan_slavic_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_pan_slavic_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_pan_slavic }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}

# ---- pan_turkic (cm_oghuz_turkic, uzbek, kazak, tatar, kirgiz) ----

	group = je_group_internal_affairs

	# 1.15 asks every entry for this; always = yes is vanilla's own default.
	activation_description = {
		always = yes
	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_pan_turkic_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_pan_turkic_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}

				desc = je_te_cm_pan_turkic_status_complete

	}

	# With the rule off, drop other countries' inactive records for good; the census re-adds one.
	disable_evaluation = {
		NOT = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
	}
	is_shown_when_inactive = {
		te_cm_system_enabled = yes
		te_cmg_pan_malay_is_candidate = yes
	}
	possible = {
		OR = {
			te_cmg_pan_malay_can_start = yes
			te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
		}
	}

	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = yes
	scripted_button = te_cmg_start_pan_malay_button
	scripted_progress_bar = te_cmg_pan_malay_bar
	progressbar = no

	# The first row whose trigger holds. Rows after the run's are an idle merge's first failing condition.
	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_rule_off
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cm_system_enabled = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_complete
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
					te_cmg_pan_malay_all_switched = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_late
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
					global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_running
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_elsewhere
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_malay_has_other_starter = yes
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_not_candidate
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						te_cmg_pan_malay_is_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_unmeasured
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_component_indonesian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_component_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_busy_1
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_hold_cm_indonesian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
					var:te_cm_held_pan_malay_cm_indonesian < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_accept_cm_indonesian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_years_cm_indonesian
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
					NOT = { te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_busy_2
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					NOR = {
						te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_hold_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					has_variable = te_cm_held_pan_malay_filipino
					var:te_cm_held_pan_malay_filipino < te_cm_hold_open
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_accept_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					has_variable = te_cm_ok_pan_malay_filipino
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_filipino = 0
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_status_years_filipino
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
								te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
							}
							te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
						}
					}
					te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
					has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino
					NOT = { te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_sol
				trigger = {
					NOT = {
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = te_cm_status_ready
				trigger = {
					te_cmg_pan_malay_can_start = yes
				}
			}
			desc = te_cm_status_pending
		}
	}

	outcome = {
		header = je_standard_completion_header
		effect_header = je_standard_on_completion_header
		color = "gold_positive"
		conclusion_desc = je_te_cm_pan_malay_complete_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
			global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
			te_cmg_pan_malay_all_switched = yes
		}
	}

	# Another country started this merge first (or it is complete under one): the entry ends silently.
	outcome = {
		flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
		conclusion_desc = te_cm_je_invalid_conclusion_desc
		trigger = {
			te_cmg_pan_malay_has_other_starter = yes
		}
	}

	# The bar follows Task 6's dominance figures. Each month the country's variable takes the script
	# value and the entry's bar takes the variable (the heir education entry's pattern). A paused system
	# leaves the bar where it stood.
	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_cm_system_enabled = yes }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_bar_pan_malay value = te_cmg_pan_malay_bar_pct }
				scope:journal_entry = {
					set_bar_progress = { name = te_cmg_pan_malay_bar value = root.var:te_cm_bar_pan_malay }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	can_deactivate = no
}
